Role: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – Agentic AI (TMS)Location: GurgaonWhat is TMS?A transportation management system (TMS) is a logistics platform that helps businesses plan, execute, and optimize the physical movement of goods, both inbound and outbound. It provides visibility into day-to-day transportation operations, ensures regulatory and trade compliance along with the associated documentation, and tracks the timely delivery of freight. A TMS streamlines shipping and makes transportation operations easier to manage and optimize.
Why Agentic TMS?Traditional TMS platforms digitize workflows but still depend on people to run them. Procurement teams run RFQs and chase spot quotes, planners build loads, coordinators chase carriers, analysts audit invoices, and support teams field customer queries. We are building AI agents that take on these jobs end to end:Agents that procure freight capacity through spot quotes, and transporter bidsAgents that plan and optimize loadsAgents that coordinate with transporter and shippersAgents that track and manage exceptionsAgents that audit and settle freight invoicesAgents that answer customer queriesThese agents run as autonomous systems, with humans in the loop only when needed. They are not copilots bolted onto screens.We are seeking an AI-first Product Builder to join our team in Gurgaon. This is a product management role for someone who builds, not just specs. You will take ideas from customer conversation to working agent yourself, using AI-assisted development to close the gap between “what if” and “it works.” To succeed, you should:Enjoy getting your hands dirtyThrive on end-to-end ownershipLet data, not opinion, drive product decisionsBe excited about defining how AI agents do real operational work in logistics
Expectations from a PM:Owns discovery and build of agentic features. This includes identifying which logistics workflows can be automated by agents, and to what degree of autonomy.Builds before writing. You prototype agents, tools, and workflows hands-on to validate an idea in days, then use the working prototype to align customers, design, and engineering.Designs agent behavior end to end:Goals, decision logic, and the tools/APIs the agent callsContext and data sourcesGuardrails, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpointsDefines and owns evaluation frameworks for agents. This covers golden datasets, accuracy and decision-quality benchmarks, regression evals before every release, and monitoring for drift in production. Evals are written and run in code, not tracked in spreadsheets.Develops and ships production code via AI-assisted tools (Kiro), and submits all changes as PRs. Owns agent prompts, tool definitions, and configs in the repo like any other code.Conducts customer discovery, starts with high-level specs, and translates insights directly into product. Everything is documented before productionizing, including agent specs, prompts, tool contracts, and eval criteria.Balances agent quality against cost and latency, including model selection, token economics, and the right mix of deterministic logic and LLM reasoning.Owns product analytics, workflow QA, release notes, and pilot customers.Drives every decision with data, from what to build to whether it worked:Sets success metrics and baselines before building, not after shippingAnalyzes agent decisions and failure patterns to decide what to fix, automate further, or roll backBacks product calls with evidence in reviews, and changes course when the data says soOwns feature correctness, rollout quality, customer adoption, and feature-level metrics in production. Agent metrics include:Automation/touchless rateDecision accuracyEscalation rateTime and cost saved per transactionBuilds user trust in agents through explainability, audit trails, and clear handoffs between agent and operator.Escalates architectural questions to dev before building, and treats review feedback as blocking.
What we are looking for:Undergraduate degree in engineering from a Tier-I institute2+ years of product management experience in enterprise-grade SaaS products or a supply chain organizationA builder’s track record: products, agents, or tools you have built and shipped yourself using AI tools, ideally including LLM-powered or agentic features in production. Links to things you’ve built are welcome.Comfort working in code, including:Reading and writing Python or TypeScript with AI assistanceWorking with Git, APIs, and SQLDebugging your own work before handing it offStrong data orientation: comfortable with numbers and analysis tools, able to work with messy operational data, and has a track record of product decisions driven by quantitative evidenceWorking understanding of:LLM capabilities and limitations (hallucination, non-determinism, context limits)Prompt and context engineeringTool/function calling and agent orchestration patternsExperience designing evals or quality frameworks for AI systems, with comfort judging when an agent is “good enough” to shipExposure to logistics or transportation workflows (procurement, planning, execution, freight audit and payment) is a strong plusStrong communication and organization skills, and the ability to think clearly, problem-solve, multi-task, and prioritizeAbility to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, with the tenacity to develop ideas independently and the conviction to drive them to completion

Role - Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)Location - GGN
About the RoleDelhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system-driven execution.This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.
What You Will DoOwn the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.Drive execution across teams — Work closely with engineering, operations, supply, business, finance, and external partners. Navigate competing priorities, make trade-offs, and take initiatives from problem discovery through rollout and adoption.
What You Bring4+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast-paced internet company.Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.Hands-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.
Why This RoleFreight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.
